question: P, Q, R, S, T and U live on six different floors of the same building. The ground floor of the building is numbered 1, the one above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. Exactly three persons live between the floors on which R and Q live. T lives immediately above the floor on which P lives. U lives immediately above the floor on which Q lives. R lives immediately below the floor on which S lives. T lives on floor number 4. Q does not live on floor number 5. Who lives on floor number 6?
solution:
Given:

1) T lives on floor number 4.

2) T lives immediately above the floor on which P lives.
